<mxCell id="C_A75j5agU9bFt2IBsdl-218" value="<ol style="line-height: 170%;"><li>Coin change flow diagram: Target amount = 7, denominations are 1, 3, and 4.</li><li>The target amount is attempted with each coin, and the result of each operation is further attempted with each coin. This process continues as long as the target amount is greater than the coin, until the target amount becomes 0. It represents an outer loop for the target amount and an inner loop for the coins.</li><li><img alt="" src="data:image/png;base64,"><br></li><li>The target amount is calculated with given coins and we store the result that gives minimum number of coins.</li><li><img alt="" src="data:image/png;base64,"><br></li><li>We observe 2 shortest paths (7 -&gt; 4 -&gt; 0 and 7 -&gt; 3 -&gt; 0) and 1 longest path (7 -&gt; 6 -&gt; 5 -&gt; 4 -&gt; 3 -&gt; 2 -&gt; 1 -&gt; 0).</li><li>We also notice that we can reduce repetitive calculations (e.g., when the target amount is 4, 3, 2, or 1) by using memoization (cache).</li></ol>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;resizeWidth=1;resizeHeight=1;treeMoving=1;fontSize=35;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="551" ol.li: Coin change flow diagram: Target amount = 7, denominations are 1, 3, and 4.

The target amount is attempted with each coin, and the result of each operation is further attempted with each coin. This process continues as long as the target amount is greater than the coin, until the target amount becomes 0. It represents an outer loop for the target amount and an inner loop for the coins.
The target amount is calculated with given coins and we store the result that gives minimum number of coins.
We observe 2 shortest paths (7 -> 4 -> 0 and 7 -> 3 -> 0) and 1 longest path (7 -> 6 -> 5 -> 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0).
We also notice that we can reduce repetitive calculations (e.g., when the target amount is 4, 3, 2, or 1) by using memoization (cache).
